text: 9-month-old infant. The patient is brought in due to a generalized nonpruritic rash for 2 days. The rash started on the trunk and spread to the extremities. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Kawasaki Disease (Incomplete) or Measles.

Given the 9-month age, high fever (40.5°C), rash spreading from trunk to extremities, and afebrile seizure, I need to distinguish between Measles (MMR vaccine status mentioned as up-to-date, but breakthrough or timing issues possible) and other causes.
